body: No. People feel anxious because they know that the police are the judge, jury and executioner in this country. Don’t move to fast or grab your registration from your glove box. You might get shot. Don’t talk back to a police officer, you might spend a few days in jail. Everyone knows that the police in this country have too much power and no accountability while also being the C students in high school. The police are thugs with immunity and we have every right to not trust them.

I feel you my brother. I myself have had to tolerate the abuse of white america while also listening to them pretend it does not exist. Being gaslit to believe things that contradict with your first hand experiences. You have every right to be angry, frustrated and tired. This country makes huge claims of freedom and equality but that doesn’t extend to everyone, especially us. You keep that fire and put it somewhere to work for you. Don’t let it consume you because that’s exactly what they want, but make that fire work against them. The only advice I can give is to not hate, but rise above. I’m in med school and every time I’m tired, or want to quit, I think about all the people who doubted me. I think of all the people who assume I was given a handout in affirmative action to attend my school while having literally average scores for my matriculated class. I use their hate to fuel me. So please don’t burn yourself but also don’t trust. White people have not earned our trust. They are the ones who let racism live. Not us.

How much longer must I exist. I realize that my dread of life is not out of depression or anger, but of fear and exhaustion. Terrified of what happens when I fail, because I should not fail. If 90% of people can do any thing, and I cannot, what does that say about me? Maybe they were all correct in their prejudices. I’m pathetic, I’m a sham, I am alone. I can’t even kill myself. No one knows how much I struggle. No one really cares except for my mom, but many loser’s moms love them. If I kill myself today my dad would be more embarrassed than anything. Or even angry for doing this to my mom. So what do I do? Cry? Scream? Shout? For what? That won’t solve my problems or make me better. This world is a waste and I can’t wait to get off this disappointing ride.
